name: site-to-map
description: Turn a personal homepage or navigation site into a folded-paper 3D map.

plugins.name: site-to-map
plugins.description: Converts a homepage, link-in-bio page or navigation site into a generated folded-paper 3D world: categories become towns, links become landmark buildings, trees, rocks or signposts. Writes a site.json and builds a standalone three.js page.
